name: Kiss x 600 Kanrinin-san no Ponytail
original_name: KISS×600 管理人さんのポニーテール
source:
Shichirouta is a university student, who now looks for an apartment to live. One day, he meets a beautiful girl in the town. She is actually a caretaker of an apartment...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
七郎太是一名正在寻找住处的大学生。一天，他在城里遇见一位美丽的女孩，而她其实是某栋公寓的管理员…
